About.headerSubtitle: Your trusted guide to authentic Sri Lankan experiences
About.welcomeP1: Ayubowan! I am Sohan Nallaperuma, a licensed National Tourist Guide Lecturer and Chauffeur Guide Lecturer with over 10 years of experience. Born and raised on this paradise island, I love showing travelers the true heart of Sri Lanka, from its ancient heritage to its hidden gems.
About.welcomeP2: I specialize in crafting personalized, hassle-free private tours tailored to your interests—whether you are seeking cultural history, wildlife safaris, scenic train rides, or tropical beaches. Let's design your dream journey together!

testimonials.name: Jessica M.
testimonials.text: Sohan is an absolute gem! We spent 10 days touring Sri Lanka with him and it felt like traveling with an old friend. His knowledge of history and nature is unmatched.

testimonials.name: Davide & Chiara
testimonials.text: Unforgettable experience! Sohan organized everything perfectly, from the safari in Yala to the train ride in Ella. He is a safe driver and a wonderful person.

testimonials.name: Thomas H.
testimonials.text: The best decision we made was booking with Sohan. He showed us hidden waterfalls and local food spots we would never have found on our own. Highly recommended!

testimonials.name: Sarah Jenkins
testimonials.text: Sohan tailored the entire trip to our interests. His passion for his country is contagious. If you're going to Sri Lanka, you need Sohan as your guide!

testimonials.name: Pierre Dubois
testimonials.text: Excellent service. Sohan was always punctual, very polite, and his english is perfect. The van was clean and comfortable for our family of four.

testimonials.name: Emily Chen
testimonials.text: A magical trip thanks to Sohan. He knew exactly when to visit popular sites to avoid crowds. The cultural triangle tour was the highlight!
